zh: 这是我昨天说的那个文件。
en: This is the file I mentioned yesterday.
alt: Here's the document I was talking about yesterday.
point: “我昨天说的”要放在名词后面：the file I mentioned

zh: 坐我旁边的那个人是新来的。
en: The guy who sits next to me is new.
alt: The person sitting next to me is new.
point: 修饰人用 who，整个从句放在名词后面

zh: 你用的那个软件叫什么？
en: What's the software you're using called?
alt: What's that app you use called?
point: 从句夹在中间：the software you're using，called 放句末

zh: 我找不到你发的那个链接。
en: I can't find the link you sent.
alt: I can't find the link that you sent me.
point: “你发的链接”是 the link you sent，不说 you sent link

zh: 你点的那个汤怎么样？
en: How's the soup you ordered?
alt: How's that soup you got?
point: “你点的汤”是 the soup you ordered，修饰语放后面

zh: 我要跟她点的一样的。
en: I'll have what she's having.
alt: I'll have the same as her.
point: “她点的（东西）”可以直接用 what 代替 the thing that

zh: 赢的那队是惠灵顿来的。
en: The team that won is from Wellington.
alt: The winning team's from Wellington.
point: “赢的那队”是 the team that won，that 作主语不能省

zh: 他是我见过跑得最快的人。
en: He's the fastest runner I've ever seen.
alt: He's the fastest person I've ever seen run.
point: 最高级 + 从句：the fastest… I've ever seen

zh: 我想要橱窗里那件。
en: I'd like the one in the window.
alt: Can I have the one in the window?
point: “那件”用 the one 代替名词；in the window 直接放后面

zh: 你昨天买的鞋穿着舒服吗？
en: Are the shoes you bought yesterday comfy?
alt: Are the shoes you got yesterday comfortable?
point: 从句插在主语里：the shoes you bought…，are 提到最前

zh: 这是去机场的那趟车吗？
en: Is this the bus that goes to the airport?
alt: Is this the airport bus?
point: “去机场的车”是 the bus that goes to…，不是 go airport bus

zh: 我们住的酒店离海滩很近。
en: The hotel we're staying at is close to the beach.
alt: Our hotel's right near the beach.
point: stay at 的 at 要留在从句末尾

zh: 医生开的药我吃完了。
en: I've finished the pills the doctor gave me.
alt: I've run out of the medicine the doctor prescribed.
point: 把话题“医生开的药”放回宾语位置：the pills the doctor gave me

zh: 我需要一个周末也开门的诊所。
en: I need a clinic that's open at the weekend.
alt: I need a clinic that opens on weekends.
point: “周末开门的诊所”是 a clinic that's open…，形容词从句放后面

zh: 住楼上的邻居人很好。
en: The neighbours upstairs are really nice.
alt: The people who live upstairs are lovely.
point: 可简化成 the neighbours upstairs，不必写 who live；neighbour 英式拼写

zh: 我借你的那把伞你放哪儿了？
en: Where did you put the umbrella I lent you?
alt: What did you do with the umbrella I lent you?
point: “我借你的”是 I lent you，借出用 lend 不用 borrow

zh: 你认识跟Tom说话的那个女孩吗？
en: Do you know the girl talking to Tom?
alt: Do you know the girl who's talking to Tom?
point: 省略 who is：the girl talking to Tom

zh: 她就是我跟你说过的那个朋友。
en: She's the friend I told you about.
alt: That's the friend I was telling you about.
point: tell you about 的 about 不能丢在从句末尾

zh: 你上个月借的钱还了吗？
en: Have you paid back the money you borrowed last month?
alt: Did you pay back the money you borrowed last month?
point: “你借的钱”是 the money you borrowed；还钱是 pay back

zh: 我在找一张没有年费的信用卡。
en: I'm after a credit card with no annual fee.
alt: I'm looking for a credit card that doesn't have an annual fee.
point: “没有年费的”可用 with no…，比完整从句更顺口

zh: 负责这个项目的经理下个月就要退休了。
en: The manager who's in charge of this project is retiring next month.
alt: The manager running this project is retiring next month.
point: 主语带长从句，别漏掉后面的谓语 is retiring

zh: 我们上周面试的那个女生已经答应来上班了。
en: The woman we interviewed last week has accepted the job.
alt: The candidate we interviewed last week has said yes to the role.
point: 关系词作宾语可省：the woman (who) we interviewed

zh: 上周五出问题的那台服务器又宕机了。
en: The server that had problems last Friday has gone down again.
alt: The server that played up last Friday has crashed again.
point: that 作主语不能省；“宕机”是 go down

zh: 我需要一个能自动备份文件的工具。
en: I need a tool that can back up my files automatically.
alt: I need something that backs up my files automatically.
point: “能…的工具”是 a tool that can…，能力放从句里

zh: 坐在角落那桌的客人一晚上都在抱怨。
en: The people sitting at the corner table have been complaining all night.
alt: The people who are sitting in the corner have been moaning all evening.
point: 省略 who are：the people sitting at…

zh: 你上次推荐的那家越南粉店真的太好吃了。
en: That pho place you recommended last time was absolutely amazing.
alt: The pho place you told me about was really good.
point: “那家店”口语用 place；you recommended 紧跟在后面

zh: 我想找一个周末能一起打羽毛球的人。
en: I'm looking for someone I can play badminton with on weekends.
alt: I'm trying to find someone to play badminton with at the weekend.
point: 介词 with 放在从句末尾：someone I can play with

zh: 昨晚达阵制胜的那个球员才十九岁。
en: The player who scored the winning try last night is only nineteen.
alt: The guy who got the match-winning try last night is just nineteen.
point: who scored… 放 player 后面；橄榄球“达阵”是 score a try

zh: 我想退掉上周在Warehouse买的那个台灯。
en: I'd like to return the lamp I bought at the Warehouse last week.
alt: I want to take back the lamp I got from the Warehouse last week.
point: 从句 I bought… 紧跟 lamp，地点时间都放从句里

zh: 卖二手家具的那家店搬到Newmarket去了。
en: The shop that sells second-hand furniture has moved to Newmarket.
alt: That second-hand furniture shop has moved to Newmarket.
point: “卖…的那家店”是 the shop that sells…

zh: 我一直想去一个能看到冰川的地方。
en: I've always wanted to go somewhere you can see glaciers.
alt: I've always wanted to visit a place where you can see a glacier.
point: 地点从句用 where，或 somewhere 后直接接从句

zh: 开车带我们环岛的那个导游以前是个渔民。
en: The guide who drove us around the island used to be a fisherman.
alt: Our guide, who drove us round the island, used to be a fisherman.
point: who drove… 修饰 guide；“以前是”用 used to be

zh: 我在找一个会说中文的家庭医生。
en: I'm looking for a GP who speaks Chinese.
alt: I'm trying to find a family doctor who can speak Mandarin.
point: “会说中文的医生”是 a GP who speaks Chinese；家庭医生叫 GP

zh: 你上次说的那个理疗师在哪个诊所上班？
en: Which clinic does that physio you mentioned work at?
alt: Where does the physio you told me about work?
point: 从句插在疑问句中间：that physio you mentioned，at 放句末

zh: 我们刚搬进去的那套房子冬天特别冷。
en: The house we've just moved into is freezing in winter.
alt: The place we just moved into gets really cold in winter.
point: move into 的 into 留在从句末尾

zh: 你能把放在桌子上的那些信拿给我吗？
en: Can you pass me the letters that are on the table?
alt: Can you grab me the letters on the table?
point: “放在桌上的”可简化为 on the table，不必写 put on

zh: 我昨晚在派对上认识了一个在Xero上班的人。
en: I met someone at the party last night who works at Xero.
alt: Last night at the party I met a guy who works for Xero.
point: 从句可与先行词分开：someone… who works at Xero

zh: 她是那种不管什么事都愿意帮忙的人。
en: She's the kind of person who'll help anyone with anything.
alt: She's the type who'd do anything to help.
point: “那种…的人”是 the kind of person who…

zh: 我们每个月花在外卖上的钱太多了。
en: The money we spend on takeaways every month is way too much.
alt: We spend way too much on takeaways every month.
point: “花在…上的钱”是 the money we spend on…；外卖叫 takeaways

zh: 那个说能帮你避税的人肯定是骗子。
en: The guy who said he could help you avoid tax is definitely a scammer.
alt: Whoever told you they could get you out of paying tax is a scammer.
point: who said he could… 修饰 the guy；“骗子”说 scammer

zh: 你上周提的那几个建议我已经转给负责采购的同事了，她这几天应该会联系你。
en: I've passed the suggestions you made last week on to the colleague who handles purchasing, so she should be in touch in the next few days.
alt: I've forwarded your suggestions from last week to our procurement person, so she'll probably get in touch in the next couple of days.
point: 两个从句：the suggestions you made / the colleague who handles…

zh: 下周开会之前，请大家先看一下附件里那份列出了所有截止日期的文档。
en: Before next week's meeting, could everyone have a read of the attached document, which lists all the deadlines?
alt: Before the meeting next week, please read through the attached document that sets out all the deadlines.
point: “列出了…的文档”可用非限定从句 , which lists…

zh: 导致昨天服务中断的那个bug已经修好了，但我们还在查是哪次改动引入的。
en: The bug that caused yesterday's outage has been fixed, but we're still working out which change introduced it.
alt: We've fixed the bug behind yesterday's outage, but we're still trying to track down which change caused it.
point: “导致中断的bug”是 the bug that caused the outage

zh: 凡是还在用旧版VPN的同事，请在周五前升级，不然下周就连不上了。
en: Anyone who's still on the old version of the VPN needs to upgrade by Friday, or they won't be able to connect next week.
alt: If you're still using the old VPN, please upgrade before Friday, otherwise you won't be able to connect next week.
point: “凡是…的人”是 anyone who…，谓语用单数 needs

zh: 我们昨晚去的那家餐厅，就是主厨上过电视的那家，说实话有点名不副实。
en: The restaurant we went to last night, the one whose chef was on TV, was honestly a bit overrated.
alt: That place we went to last night, the one with the TV chef, honestly didn't live up to the hype.
point: whose 表示所属：the one whose chef…；“名不副实”说 overrated

zh: 如果你想找个能带孩子、又有户外座位的咖啡馆，我知道Ponsonby有一家很不错。
en: If you're after a café where you can take the kids and sit outside, I know a great one in Ponsonby.
alt: If you want a kid-friendly café with outdoor seating, there's a really good one in Ponsonby.
point: where 引导地点从句；“有一家”用 a great one 代替

zh: 那个从小就在我们俱乐部训练的女孩，刚刚入选了黑蕨队。
en: The girl who's been training at our club since she was little has just made the Black Ferns.
alt: The girl who's trained at our club since she was a kid has just been picked for the Black Ferns.
point: 长主语 who's been training… 之后别忘了谓语；入选说 make the team

zh: 教练跟我说过最有用的一句话是：比赛结果你控制不了，你能控制的只有自己的态度。
en: The best advice our coach ever gave me was that the result is out of your hands, and the only thing you can control is your attitude.
alt: The most useful thing my coach ever told me was that you can't control the result, only your attitude.
point: “你能控制的”是 the only thing you can control

zh: 我在网上买的那件外套跟照片完全不一样，我周一就给卖家发了邮件，到现在还没回。
en: The jacket I bought online looks nothing like the photos, and the seller, who I emailed on Monday, still hasn't got back to me.
alt: The jacket I ordered online is nothing like the pictures, and I emailed the seller on Monday but they still haven't replied.
point: 非限定从句 , who I emailed…, 插在主语和谓语之间

zh: 你还记得我们圣诞节前去的那个商场吗？就是停车场永远找不到位子的那个。
en: Do you remember the mall we went to before Christmas? The one where you could never find a park?
alt: Remember that shopping centre we went to before Christmas, where it was impossible to find a park?
point: the one where… 补充说明；新西兰“停车位”常说 a park

zh: 我们在皇后镇住的那个Airbnb，房东人特别好，还开车带我们去了一个只有当地人才知道的湖。
en: The host of the Airbnb we stayed at in Queenstown was lovely, and drove us out to a lake that only locals know about.
alt: Our Airbnb host in Queenstown was really nice and even took us to a lake only the locals know about.
point: 两个从句：the Airbnb we stayed at / a lake only locals know about

zh: 要是你有什么想带回国的东西，比如麦卢卡蜂蜜，最好到机场之前就买好，机场里卖的贵很多。
en: If there's anything you want to take home, like manuka honey, buy it before you get to the airport, because the stuff they sell there is way pricier.
alt: If you want to take anything home, like manuka honey, get it before the airport, since everything they sell there costs a lot more.
point: “想带回去的东西”是 anything you want to take home

zh: 公司给我们买的保险只报一部分专科费用，所以需要做手术的人还是得自己掏不少钱。
en: The insurance our company provides only covers part of the specialist fees, so people who need surgery still end up paying a fair bit themselves.
alt: Our work insurance only covers some of the specialist costs, so anyone who needs an operation still has to pay quite a lot out of pocket.
point: the insurance our company provides；泛指“…的人”用 people who…

zh: 给我做膝盖手术的医生说，我至少要等六周才能重新开始跑步。
en: The surgeon who operated on my knee said I'd have to wait at least six weeks before I could start running again.
alt: The surgeon who did my knee said I can't start running again for at least six weeks.
point: “给我做手术的医生”是 the surgeon who operated on my knee

zh: 这周末我们要把车库里那些好几年没碰过的东西清掉，有你想要的就拿走。
en: This weekend we're clearing out all the stuff in the garage that we haven't touched in years, so grab anything you want.
alt: We're sorting out the garage this weekend and getting rid of everything we haven't used in years, so help yourself to anything you like.
point: 从句可与先行词隔开：the stuff in the garage that…；anything you want

zh: 那个漏了好几个月的水龙头，房东终于要派人来修了。
en: The landlord's finally sending someone round to fix the tap that's been leaking for months.
alt: The landlord is finally getting someone in to fix that tap that's been dripping for months.
point: 话题前置要还原：fix the tap that's been leaking…；水龙头叫 tap

zh: 你还记得我们刚来新西兰时帮了我们很多的那个邻居吗？她下个月要搬去澳洲了。
en: Remember that neighbour who helped us out so much when we first came to New Zealand? She's moving to Australia next month.
alt: Do you remember the neighbour who was so good to us when we first arrived in New Zealand? She's moving to Australia next month.
point: who helped us out… 修饰 neighbour；口语可省 Do you

zh: Toastmasters里给我提意见最多的那位老会员，也是当初鼓励我去参加演讲比赛的人。
en: The long-time member at Toastmasters who's given me the most feedback is also the one who talked me into entering the speech contest.
alt: The longtime Toastmasters member who gives me the most feedback is the same person who encouraged me to enter the speech contest.
point: 两层从句：the member who… / the one who talked me into…

zh: 我们之前看的那套带大后院的房子，听说已经以高于标价的价格卖出去了。
en: That house we looked at, the one with the big backyard, apparently went for more than the asking price.
alt: Apparently the house we saw with the big backyard sold for over the asking price.
point: the one with… 代替从句；“高于标价”说 over the asking price

zh: 我想找个能帮我理清KiwiSaver和投资的理财顾问，最好是收费透明、不靠卖产品拿佣金的那种。
en: I'm looking for a financial adviser who can help me sort out my KiwiSaver and investments, ideally someone whose fees are clear and who doesn't work on commission.
alt: I want a financial adviser who can help me get my KiwiSaver and investments sorted, preferably one with transparent fees who isn't paid on commission.
point: who can help…；whose fees are clear；“理清”说 sort out
